Change the AMOUNT prop type from `AMOUNT: number` to `AMOUNT: number | null` (line 20). In the template: - header sub (line 37): 'Review your details before payment.' -> 'Review your details before registering.' - wrap the
block (lines 55-61) in {#if AMOUNT} ... {/if} - the confirm Button (lines 68-75): label becomes {#if isProcessing}Processing{:else}Confirm registration{/if} and drop 'Confirm & Pay {formatCurrency(AMOUNT)}'. - the

(line 77) -> wrap in {#if AMOUNT}. Keep formatCurrency (still used by the amount row when AMOUNT is set - the dead-code RegistrationForm.svelte and any future pay step). register_page_free.s:
Register page: submit WITHOUT payment, land on dashboard.

File: src/routes/register/+page.svelte.

1. Script changes:
- Rename confirmPayment -> submitRegistration; body: POST /api/register (was /api/register-init-payment, line 230) with the SAME payload (firstName, lastName, email, phone, school, password, partnerCode). On ok: const d = await r.json(); try { localStorage.setItem('active_reg', d.registrationId); } catch {}; await goto('/dashboard'). On !r.ok: throw new Error(e.error || 'Registration failed') -> apiError. Delete the whole Paystack popup block (dynamic import '@paystack/inline-js', resumeTransaction, auth_url fallback, onSuccess/onCancel/onError, lines 240-262). Delete registrationId state (line 68) and the 'Invalid response from payment gateway' throw.
- Keep handleSubmit -> validateForm -> showConfirmation (modal still shown, now free).
2. ConfirmationModal usage (lines 422-432): pass AMOUNT={0} (free mode; the component now renders 'Confirm registration').
3. Copy:
- reg-per span (line 402): 'per participant' -> 'full access, optional'.
- reg-summary-note (line 405): replace the whole 'Portal access is free for everyone from August 1 to August 10; from August 11, continued participation requires the ₦15,000 registration fee...' sentence with: 'Registration is free for everyone. The ₦15,000 fee unlocks full access to e4 Chess Coach, TEAMUP and the Taskify Development Passport, payable anytime from the dashboard. With a partner code, full access is ₦13,500. Participants may join the championship journey at any time before the online training phase concludes on September 10, 2026.'
- Keep the second reg-summary-note ('However, early registration is highly recommended...') and the reg-fine line ('Online coaching begins August 1, 2026, players get access on registration.') - both stay true.
- Partner discount callout (line 375, '10% discount applied, ₦1,500 off') stays - it now advertises the discounted unlock fee.
4. The AMOUNT state (baseAmount / validatePartnerCode setting AMOUNT) is now unused by the modal but still drives the discount callout - keep it.

Verification: `pnpm check` (type-check the removed registrationId/paystack vars), `pnpm test`. Manually smoke the flow in the browser: logged-out register -> modal 'Confirm registration' -> POST /api/register -> dashboard with the unlock button (dashboard step not built yet - dashboard will just show the reg as pending; that is fine). Commit scoped to this step.

docs_update.s:
Update the authoritative docs per repo AGENTS.md (docs/about.md must reflect the new model).

1. docs/about.md:
- Line 66 (Stage 2 bullet): 'Portal access is FREE for everyone Aug 1–10, 2026; from Aug 11 the ₦15,000 registration fee applies' -> 'Registration is free for everyone; the ₦15,000 fee unlocks full access to e4, TEAMUP and the Taskify Development Passport, payable anytime from the dashboard'.
- Section 5.1 (lines 187-191): replace the 'Pay the registration fee via Paystack' + 'Confirmation is immediate upon successful payment' bullets with: '- Register free of charge; full access is unlocked with the optional ₦15,000 fee via Paystack' and '- Full access is granted immediately upon successful payment'.
- Section 5.3 (lines 202-208): rewrite as: '### 5.3 Full Access Fee\n- Registration is FREE for everyone\n- **Full access:** ₦15,000 per participant, payable anytime from the dashboard\n- **With partner discount (10% off):** ~₦13,500 per participant\n- Payment is processed securely by **Paystack**\n- Fees are non-refundable except if BEEE cancels the event'.
- Section 5.5 (lines 216-224): rewrite the flow to: '1. User fills form → clicks Register\n2. Confirmation modal appears with participant summary\n3. Registration is created instantly, free of charge; user lands on /dashboard\n4. Dashboard shows an unlock full access button while the registration is pending\n5. Clicking it opens the Paystack inline popup for the ₦15,000 fee (or ₦13,500 with a partner code)\n6. On success → redirects to /payment/callback?reference=XXX\n7. The callback page verifies payment via /api/verify-payment\n8. Full access is granted, account provisioned, confirmation email sent'.
- Line 30 fee row: 'Registration fee | ₦15,000 (standard) / ~₦13,500 with partner discount' -> 'Full access fee | ₦15,000 (standard) / ~₦13,500 with partner discount'.
- Lines 379-384 (registration flow) and the routes table lines 394-395: '/api/register-init-payment | Initiate registration + payment' -> two rows: '/api/register | Free registration (creates pending registration + login account)' and '/api/register-init-payment | Initiate Paystack payment for an existing pending registration (unlock full access)'; update the flow bullets to match (register is free; payment is initiated from the dashboard unlock button).
- Section 6.1 step 4 and 6.2 stay (commissions still fire on confirmed payment) - no change.
2. docs/data-model.md lines 55-69: update the flow diagram node 'register-init-payment' to the two-step model: register (free, pending) -> dashboard unlock button -> register-init-payment (paystack init on existing reg) -> verify -> paid; adjust the 'pending reg point holds the password hash' note: the hash is now also used to provision the login account at registration.

Verification: `pnpm test && pnpm check` (docs are not compiled, gate is a sanity check). Commit scoped to this step.

1. src/lib/integration/register-payout.test.ts: the register() helper (lines 43-51) now posts to /api/register and imports '../../routes/api/register/+server'. The $lib/db vi.mock (lines 17-20) must add find_or_create_user: db.find_or_create_user - so add that function to the harness (src/test/harness.ts QdrantStore): same reuse semantics as find_or_create_player_user (lines 44-53) but WITHOUT the rpb line, signature (email, password_hash?, phones?) -> returns existing or new user id, stores p/ph. The register response now comes from /api/register: { success, registrationId, amount, discounted } - the existing assertions (init.discounted, init.amount, init.registrationId) keep working unchanged. The $lib/server/session mock (line 32) already exists; the register() call must pass cookies: { set: vi.fn() } in the handler args. Add one new integration assertion in test I2 after the register call, BEFORE verify: the user row for 'player@example.com' exists but has NO rpb yet (expect(user.c).toBeUndefined()); after verify it contains rpb (existing assertion line 93 already covers the after state).
2. e2e/register-payout.spec.ts: new_reg (lines 11-21) posts to /api/register with the same data and returns d.registrationId (drop the payment-init semantics - the e2e Paystack mock makes the callback verify succeed against the pending reg's amt, so E1/E3 tests keep passing unchanged).
3. src/lib/db/find_or_create_player_user.test.ts, confirm.ts, webhook, verify-payment tests: unchanged (confirm() still calls find_or_create_player_user which now no-ops the class add for existing users - it already handles existing users at src/lib/db/index.ts:387-396).

Run `pnpm vitest run src/lib/integration/register-payout.test.ts` green, then `pnpm test && pnpm check`. e2e is optional (needs a running dev server + env) - note in the commit message if skipped. Commit scoped to this step.

gate_final.s:
Final gate + sweep.

1. Run `pnpm test` and `pnpm check` (svelte-check + tsc) and fix any fallout not caught by earlier steps (e.g. other tests that referenced /api/register-init-payment's old create semantics, or the orphaned src/components/RegistrationForm.svelte / src/App.svelte - those are unreachable legacy entry points (main.ts mounts App.svelte but SvelteKit routes via +layout.svelte, no route imports RegistrationForm); if type-check complains about them, leave them untouched - they compile today and are out of scope; if `pnpm check` errors on them, that error exists on main too, verify with git stash).
2. Confirm no stray references to the old copy remain: grep for 'from August 11' and 'per participant' under src/ - every hit must be resolved or knowingly cosmetic.
3. git status clean, commit any stragglers, push.
4. Delete plan/free_registration.plan.json once `plan free_registration` prints 0.
